name: study-hub
description: 面向 macOS / Windows 的学习资料管理系统：统一管理学学习时间、学习计划与学习资料，并提供提醒与监督复盘。
author: Study Hub

scripts.serve:web: node web/build.js && node -e "const h=require('http'),f=require('fs'),p=require('path'),D='web/dist';h.createServer((q,s)=>{let r=decodeURIComponent(q.url.split('?')[0]);if(r==='/')r='/index.html';const F=p.join(D,r);if(!f.existsSync(F)||f.statSync(F).isDirectory()){s.writeHead(404);return s.end('404')}const T={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.png':'image/png','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.json':'application/json'}[p.extname(F)]||'application/octet-stream';s.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':T});s.end(f.readFileSync(F))}).listen(8080,'127.0.0.1',()=>console.log('http://127.0.0.1:8080/'))"
